errors.evidence: There is a spelling error in the word "Рекицилиране"; the correct spelling from the chart legend is "Рециклиране".
The description omits the numerical prefixes (38.1, 38.2, 38.3) which are part of the full legend labels for each category.
The starting value of the blue line in 2018 is approximately 9,300, not 9,500. The point is visibly far below the halfway mark between 9,000 and 10,000.

The phrase "се подобрява леко" (improves slightly) is subjective and an unwanted interpretation. It is also factually misleading, as the value for this line decreases from approximately 9,300 to 8,900. The description should state the trend neutrally.
The final value of the blue line in 2022 is approximately 8,900, which is below the 9,000 mark, not 9,300.
The final value of the orange line in 2022 is visibly below the 3,000 mark, at approximately 2,900, not 3,000.
The final value of the grey line in 2022 is approximately 2,500 (at the halfway mark between 2,000 and 3,000), not 2,350.
